(AIG Letterhead)

September 15, 2011

VIA EDGAR CORRESPONDENCE 

Mr. Jeffrey Riedler

Assistant Director

Securities and Exchange Commission

Division of Corporation Finance

100 F Street, NE

Mail Stop 4720

Washington, D.C. 20549

Re: 

American International Group, Inc. 

Form 10-Q for the Quarterly Period Ended June 30, 2011 

Filed August 4, 2011 

File No. 001-08787 

Dear Mr. Riedler:

Thank you for taking the time yesterday to discuss with me your letter dated September 1, 2011
with respect to American International Group, Inc. s Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June
30, 2011. As indicated on our call, we are gathering information to prepare our written response
and expect to be in a position to provide a response through an EDGAR filing no later than
September 30, 2011.

Thank you again for your consideration. If you have any questions or require any additional
information, please do not hesitate to contact me at (212) 770-5123.

Very truly yours,

/s/ Kathleen E. Shannon

Kathleen E. Shannon 

Senior Vice President

and Deputy General Counsel
